newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine legislator held in rape case - official.
newsitem.headline: Philippine legislator held in rape case - official.

text.p: Philippine authorities have captured a Congressman who has been on the run for more than three weeks after being charged with the statutory rape of an 11-year old girl, a government spokesman said.
A handcuffed Romeo Jalosjos was presented to reporters by officials of the Presidential Security Group (PSG), who arrested him on an islet in Bataan province, northwest of the capital Manila.

"I am confused. I don't know what's happening to me. There's only one victim in this case and that is me," Jalosjos told reporters. He repeated previous statements that he had been unjustly tried in the media.
Jalosjos has denied allegations by the girl that he had sex with her several times in his Manila apartment on payment of up to 10,000 pesos ($385) each time.
A judge ordered the 56-year-old Jalosjos arrested on December 26 on two counts of statutory rape and 12 counts of acts of lasciviousness.
He was not in court when the judge issued the arrest warrant and when police went to his house to serve the warrant, Jalosjos had fled.
PSG chief Jose Calimlim told reporters that Jalosjos had planned to flee to Malaysia before heading to London.
The foreign office had sought Jakarta's help in locating Jalosjos after police said they received a tip-off that he had taken a boat to Indonesia.
